faqs.question: What floor plans does Lakeview at Gateway Park offer?
faqs.answer: Lakeview offers 8 floor plans: four one-bedroom layouts (689-832 sq ft), three two-bedroom layouts (920-1,118 sq ft), and one three-bedroom layout (1,314 sq ft). Prices range from $1,450 to $2,605 per month (as of Q3 2026).

faqs.question: Does Lakeview have a lake?
faqs.answer: Yes. Lakeview features a community fishing lake with jogging trails along the waterfront. The lakeside setting provides scenic water views from select apartments.

faqs.question: Are pets allowed at Lakeview?
faqs.answer: Yes. Lakeview allows up to 2 pets per unit. Pet deposit is $300. Monthly pet fee is $35 per pet. Breed restrictions may apply. A leash-free bark park is on site.

faqs.question: Is there a move-in special?
faqs.answer: Yes. Select apartment homes currently offer up to two months free. Contact the leasing office at (983) 200-7494 for eligible floor plans.

faqs.question: How far is Lakeview from downtown Denver?
faqs.answer: Approximately 20 minutes via I-70. The 40th Ave and Airport Blvd light rail station is walking distance, providing direct rail to Union Station downtown and Denver International Airport.

faqs.question: Is Lakeview near public transit?
faqs.answer: Yes. The 40th Ave and Airport Blvd light rail station is steps from the community. The A Line connects directly to DIA and Union Station downtown.

faqs.question: What amenities does Lakeview offer?
faqs.answer: Amenities include a community fishing lake, resort pool with cabanas, heated spa, 24-hour fitness center with yoga studio and group classes, leash-free bark park, resident clubhouse, outdoor kitchen, business center, and gated parking with optional private garages.

faqs.question: What apartment features are included?
faqs.answer: Apartments include granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, subway tile backsplash, wood-style flooring, breakfast bars, deep soaking tubs, in-home washer/dryer, walk-in closets, and private patios or balconies. Select homes have fireplaces and lake views.

faqs.question: Is parking available?
faqs.answer: Yes. Gated surface lot parking is included. Private detached garages are available for $140 per month. A separate $10 monthly third-party parking fee applies.

faqs.question: What are the office hours?
faqs.answer: Tuesday through Friday 10am to 6pm, Saturday 10am to 5pm. Closed Sunday and Monday. Tours can be scheduled online.
